name: selection-offers-only-what-the-task-needs
description: SPEC.md 4.15: what an agent carries and what a run is offered are different things. A selector names the offered subset; the withheld tool's catalog line never reaches any model, and the withheld tool never runs - because a model offered a tool will sometimes act on it because it was shown, not because the task needs it (the motivating production finding: a greeting ran a web search six times). Selection narrows the offering only: the run still answers, and the offered tool works exactly as before.
